note: City of Canton campground on the Mississippi riverfront at 700 N. Front St, near Lock and Dam 20, with a playground, shelter house and levee walk; the riverside park floods at high water, closing the campground and the road in (as in 2019). --Claude
summary: City page + Let's Camp: $40 per 24 h, 23 pads with 20/30/50A and water, sewer at 10-23, reservable online (Let's Camp, open through 2027) or by phone, 30-night max. Imagery: no levee or street between pads and river, but the campground's own riverside lane and the riprap bank are - so riverfront is a re-audit lead down to riverview. No current flood closure found.
flags: WATERFRONT re-audit lead (stored riverfront -> riverview): on Esri imagery the 23 angled concrete pads (~40.1366-40.1378,-91.5155) sit riverward of Front Street and the railroad, with no levee between them and the river; but on their river side runs a ~6 m paved lane (the pads' access lane / levee walk) and then a ~5 m riprap bank before the water, ~12-15 m in all. A campground's own lane between pad and water blocks on-water, so this reads riverview (open, unobstructed sightline across the Mississippi) rather than riverfront.

STATUS: no current closure found - Let's Camp status 'open' with bookable dates 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31; the city page posts no closure. Reviews record a flood closure in October 2019 (park and road closed), and a river-stage alert note says Front Street to the campground floods at 16.6 ft. No status written.

Booking link: the city's 'Make Reservation' goes to https://letscamp.ca/camps/mississippi-riverfront-campground (Let's Camp, recorded as platform operator with that url). Phone 573-288-4412 option 2 (matches stored).
Pin: 40.1360,-91.5160 sits at the Front Street/railroad crossing south of the pads, ~130 m from their centre; within 250 m, optional move to 40.1372,-91.5155.
